text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ and I have just finished
our
training session for the day.

Hm? Where's my bottle? Did I leave it
on the
track?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I need to get my bottle.
I'll head
straight home afterward.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: It's dark already, so I'll go with you.

text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure it was around there...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Did you not hear us the first time? We
have a
race coming up soon so get out
of our way and
scram.
text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Excuse you? I'm in your way? That's strange because I'm pretty sure I was here first.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What does that matter to us? Seriously,
get lost
already!
text_block_list.name: Sharp-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Oh, now you're asking for it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Looks like it... I'm going to see what's
wrong.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I was under the impression that there
were no
restrictions on the use of this
track today.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Great, another nosy meddler. What do
you want?
text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Hayahide?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to understand if special
permission is
required to use this track
today for some reason.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If so, please let me know who I need to
speak to
in order to get permission. I can
go to them on
Taishin's behalf.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Well, uh... It's not exactly...
text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Apologies, I couldn't quite hear you. It's not exactly what? Are you saying that special permission is not required to use this track?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
In that case, would you care to explain
why you
told Taishin to leave? Did she
commit some sort
of infraction, perhaps?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If she interfered with your training in any
way,
please let me know.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Uh... Um...
text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Can it be that you
had no
legitimate reason to harass
Taishin and simply
wanted to throw your
weight around?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then I believe it's you who is in the wrong.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ngh! Okay, we get it already!
text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
This is so stupid! Let's just get out of
here!
text_block_list.name: Sharp-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
The two are no match for Biwa
Hayahide's cold,
hard logic and run off
without another word.

Honestly, the audacity! Acting like
they're the
only ones allowed on the
track...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. You didn't need to do that for
me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's fine. I don't mind.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Try not to stay out too late, okay? And
make sure
to eat something once you
get back to the dorm.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hehe, good!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: That was so awesome of you!

Your logical thinking and reasoning got them
good!

Your logical argument and reasoning got them
good!

text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: That was so awesome of you!

Your logical thinking and reasoning got them
good!

Your logical argument and reasoning got them
good!

text_block_list.text:
R-really? I was just being my usual self,
honestly...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I will say one thing, though.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The best way to handle overly emotional

arguments is to strike them down with
sound
logic.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Doing so usually trips up the other
person so
much, they give up on their
own.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect it to have come in handy
in such a
situation.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I know sometimes I can come off as cold
and
inflexible because of my overly
logical thinking,
but...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If I can use it to help my friends out,
then I think
it's safe to call it a strength.
Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
After successfully defending a friend,
Biwa
Hayahide seems to feel even more
confident in
her reasoning abilities.

Бива Хаяхидэ is a little prouder of her
logical
approach to things than usual
today.
